title: Skeletons & Sidearms
description: Skeletons learn the art of Mace PVP
body:
![Skeletons & Sidearms Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63cb093400cc5ad576365dcc442211a2aaaa9677.png)
**This data pack turns Skeletons and their variants into scrappy little minibosses by allowing them to swap between different weapons when fighting the player.**

Skeletons will swap to a mace at close range and use wind charges to bounce themselves in the air to land a devastating critical blow!
![A Skeleton using a wind charge.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbac73a87c5cb55b2bee1a07ee402bcab1b88768_0.webp)

Parcheds use a golden spear to deliver a staggering dash attack to check players who get too close.
![A Parched giving an unarmored player a good spearing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a29af3b1e5a273691258afbfa7d1950b7e97a1cc.png)

Wither Skeletons can two forms of damage over time with their flaming arrows and withering axe strikes.
![A Wither Skeleton fires a flaming arrow.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3450ebae31de5a3f657ec36314fdd673cdb01bc.png)

Boggeds swap between bow, sword, and shield-breaking axe attacks to keep up the pressure! They wear a leather cap that protects them from sunlight.
![A Bogged preparing to disable a shield with its iron axe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfd88e886059881d95875a678d2e3d99b68fef2d_0.webp)

Strays perform mace attacks similarly to skeletons, but also swap to an axe at close range to cleave shields. They also wear leather boots and a chainmail helmet. Scary!
![A Stray aiming its bow while soaring through the air.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53a86706f736abc8a9840238a89847c04332e3a5.png)

Works with vanilla Minecraft, no resource packs required.
